scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @relay/contracts build && concurrently -n runtime,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @relay/runtime dev" "pnpm --filter @relay/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @relay/contracts build && pnpm --filter @relay/runtime build && pnpm --filter @relay/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @relay/contracts build && pnpm --filter @relay/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @relay/web typecheck
